question: On independently licensed raw-text counterfactuals, does original Q-RMEA preserve correct decisions under relation-preserving surface-name changes while remaining sensitive to a relation-changing coreference edit, and which observed state/weight versus utility changes accompany failure?

mathematical_objects.accounting: Delta z=sum Delta alpha*u+sum alpha*Delta u+sum Delta alpha*Delta u, only for aligned positions. Known arithmetic, not causal mediation; no hybrid predictor execution is needed.

interpretation: Preserving edit failure dominated by utility changes motivates investigating contextual/value pathway before a measurement-only remedy.
Preserving failure with limited utility change and substantial weight response is a scorer-sensitivity hypothesis, requiring matched controls; not quantum attribution.
Invariance without correct changed-relation responses is insufficient.
All three correct supplies no observed failure requiring a new debiasing method; changed internal attention is not a reason to intervene.
nearest_work_boundary: No CoRE output subtraction or validation coefficients, no VIB embedding blend/KL/retraining, no post-contextual mask asserted as input invariance. Counterfactual controls/invariance/accounting are known tools and must not be renamed as innovation.
kill_criteria: Semantic licensing fails or only unverified type metadata supports it
Unconditional name-invariance erases legitimate identity/coreference information
Utility pathway undermines a measurement-only explanation
Only states/attention stable while complete decisions fail either control
Matched controls show same behavior: no quantum-specific attribution
Counterfactual selection or thresholds fitted on exposed validation
limits: One triplet can falsify an exact behavioral claim, not establish population robustness/utility. Retain originally misclassified bases; invariance attribution there is inconclusive, never replace after outputs.
primary_resolution: Accept as one exploratory diagnostic question, no supported new method. Design permits at most16bases from fixed first32train IDs, at most48input forwards only after semantic certificates and exact worker review/scheduler gate. No model call has been made.
